# The Pebbles Collection (Μύκονος)

> Three private-pool villas in Super Paradise, Mykonos, for up to 37 guests, two minutes from the beach. Daily housekeeping. Book direct, best price.

## Στοιχεία
- Διεύθυνση: Super Paradise, 846 00 Μύκονος
- Τηλέφωνο: +30 694 090 9733
- Email: thepebblescollection@gmail.com
- Περιοχές: Μύκονος, Super Paradise, Νότια Μύκονος, Κυκλάδες
- Γλώσσες: Ελληνικά, English

## Υπηρεσίες
- Βίλες με ιδιωτική πισίνα στη Μύκονο
- Βίλα για μεγάλες παρέες στη Μύκονο

- Bachelor και bachelorette ταξίδια στη Μύκονο

## Συχνές ερωτήσεις
- **Where exactly are the villas?** In Super Paradise, in the south of Mykonos. Super Paradise Beach is 1.2 kilometres away, about two minutes by car, the airport seven minutes and Mykonos Town ten minutes.
- **How many guests does each villa sleep?** Villa I sleeps up to 13 adults, Villa II up to 11 and Villa III up to 13. The whole estate, with all three villas together, sleeps up to 37 guests in 17 bedrooms. One extra bed can be added in each villa.
- **Does each villa have its own pool?** Yes. Each villa has its own private, ecological pool that runs without chemicals. The pools of Villa II and Villa III also have a stone cascade.
- **Is housekeeping included?** Yes. Daily housekeeping, including making up the beds, is included in every stay at no extra charge, both indoors and outdoors.
- **What are the check-in and check-out times?** Check-in is from 15:00 and check-out is by 12:00. If you need a different time, let us know and we will do our best to help.
- **Can you arrange transfers, a chef or a massage?** Yes, on request and through our partners: private transfers 24 hours a day, a chef who prepares breakfast or meals every day, massage and spa treatments, as well as cocktail parties and events at the villas.
- **Do I need a car?** It is not essential, but it helps. Each villa has private parking for at least three cars, and with our private transfers you can move around without looking for parking on the island’s busy roads.
- **How do I book?** Send us your dates and the size of your group by WhatsApp, e-mail or phone on +30 694 090 9733 and we will send you an offer. Your booking is confirmed with a 10% deposit, and booking direct always gets you the best price.
- **Are they suitable for large groups and events?** Yes. The villas have hosted family gatherings, groups of friends and bachelor and bachelorette trips. Large groups can book two or all three villas together, and cocktail parties and events can be arranged on request.
